text: The meeting highlighted a scope and goal misalignment, with participants misunderstanding the project goal and confusing it with another product.
There is no written project plan or budget yet; a written plan is required in two weeks covering functional and technical design, staffing, timeframe, budget, and market plan.
The UI group will build the overall plan incorporating inputs from usability, marketing, and design groups.
The group decided to focus the project on designing a remote control for television as the first product, and the project plan is to be delivered in two weeks.
